q06 near aisle 65/54/54, hp 6.7 against c_27312 at 62/52/52, hp 6.2: now on the photo's grain. There is no repeat or moire (low-frequency std 0.95). The mid-aisle warm shift in the photo is still not reproduced.

Now dark brown heather with light flecks, matching f_17313's grain (hp 8.0 vs 7.2) and level (L47 vs 46). The hue is a touch warmer/yellower (h23 vs h11-15). In the long F aisle view (f_toJ) it reads as cut pile with no visible tile repeat, and its scale suits the narrow 1-2-1 aisles. It is the same tile as J, so the two floors share grain and differ only in colour. That is consistent with f_17300 / c_27315, but f_17300 shows coarser, sparser light flecks.

The door-2 strip now has heather (hp 4.5-5.3, previously 1.9-2.1), and its mean is unchanged (68,59,50, h30). The strip is ~0.55 m deep, so 1.5 tiles fit across it and no repeat is possible. It reads as carpet at the vinyl edge rather than a painted band.

Unchanged. Hue right; speckle about half the photo's.
